BreadcrumbNavigation

The `m3e-breadcrumb` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Anatomy

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.breadcrumb []
…
[ M3e.breadcrumbItem [] [ Kit.text "Dashboard" ]
, M3e.breadcrumbItem [] [ Kit.text "Reports" ]
, M3e.breadcrumbItem [] [ Kit.text "Annual" ]
]
M3e.Breadcrumb.el { content = M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Dashboard" ] }
[]
[ M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Reports" ]
, M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Annual" ]
]
M3e.Breadcrumb.build { content = M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Dashboard" ] }
|> M3e.Breadcrumb.withChild (M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Reports" ])
|> M3e.Breadcrumb.withChild (M3e.BreadcrumbItem.view [] [ Kit.text "Annual" ])
|> M3e.Breadcrumb.toElement
<m3e-breadcrumb>
…
<m3e-breadcrumb-item>Dashboard</m3e-breadcrumb-item>
<m3e-breadcrumb-item>Reports</m3e-breadcrumb-item>
<m3e-breadcrumb-item>Annual</m3e-breadcrumb-item>
</m3e-breadcrumb>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-breadcrumb produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.

M3eComponentsBuilderRaw
Constructor
breadcrumb : List.List (M3e.Attr M3e.Component.Breadcrumb.Attrs msg) -> List.List (M3e.Element M3e.Component.Breadcrumb.Content (M3e.Component.Breadcrumb.ChildAdmittedBy childAdm) msg) -> M3e.Element (M3e.Component.Breadcrumb.Is s) admittedBy msg

The loose m3e-breadcrumb producer — open attribute/child rows, no required record. See M3e.Component.Breadcrumb.component for the required-content form.
